Document regime is national — the traveller's documents come from home country though; the entry cable targets visa applicants with discrepancy — for a visitor whose home passport is consistent, exposure lower; but the Feb 2025 cable about trans athletes etc. Foreign governments issued advisories.

So our case is arguably below 0.55-B? 0.55-B's exposure = repeated hostile ferry/guesthouse treatment with partial remedies.
